run_extract_attribute_vocabulary_cli: run the CLI to extract attribute vocabulary from a numpy training file for the furniture domain
run_extract_fashion_attributes: run the CLI to extract attribute vocabulary from a numpy training file for the fashion domain
call_extract_action_attributes: call extract_action_attributes to parse training data and build an attribute vocabulary dictionary
call_print_fashion_attributes: call print_fashion_attributes to print fashion attribute vocabulary sorted by count
run_cli_with_custom_save_path: run the CLI with a custom vocab save path and train numpy path for attribute extraction
